name: LootboxSpawnAreaType - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: A lootbox type allowed to spawn in a spawn area. Created from the area's Allowed types step (Create New Join Entry).

steps.description: One type that may spawn in this area. An area without entries allows every enabled type.

fields.label: Box type
fields.description: Picked by its spawn weight among the area's allowed types. A disabled type or one with spawn weight 0 never spawns, even when listed.
